source: Rust 1.97.1 slice::sort_by (driftsort); elements are ids 0..n-1 of a type with size elemSize; comparator kinds below, h3/mix as in tests/lean/Tests/Core/RustSort.lean

kinds.2: model order: Equal if either key < 0, else key compare
kinds.3: NaN floats: key < 0 is NaN, partial_cmp().unwrap_or(Equal)
kinds.5: noisy: if h3(seed,a,b)%16==0 then ord3(h3>>8) else key compare
kinds.6: model order if both keys >= 0, else compare h3(seed,id,0)%(n+1)

cmpHash: FNV-1a 64 over the comparator argument ids a0,b0,a1,b1,... (decimal string)
